messages:
nina: Quick lock 1026026026026 1: were targeting Wed 09:00 PT for the public announce. Need final changelog permalink, canonical docs link, and a staging preview by 5pm so comms can schedule social/email.

matt: on it. Im finishing one last callout on adaptive batching behavior. Will merge within the hour.

jamal: once matt merges Ill publish the docs redirect and a short migration note. Will post the canonical link here.

liam: webinar scheduled at 11:00 PT same day. marketing wants a concise headline for the blog + a single metric for the hero section. can we confirm a clean % number?

matt: benchmark summary (p95 web workload): 30-40% token cost reduction with new batching + 5-10ms p95 latency change depending on sequence length. use "up to 40%" on hero and call out typical workloads in the paragraph.

nina: perfect. I'll craft: "Up to 40% lower per-token costs on typical web workloads" + wave CTA for webinar. jamal, we'll put a small footnote linking to the full benchmarks.

ci-cd-bot: build queued: refs/heads/release-1.3 -> staging-preview. build id: 6789abc.

matt: merged PR 4321. changelog permalink ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/releases/tag/v1.3 (draft release created).

jamal: docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/1.3 and canonical landing at https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/release-1.3. added "Migration & examples" section and anchors for batching docs.

nina: staging preview? need the preview URL for screenshots and social cards.

ci-cd-bot: preview deployment successful: https://staging-preview.redwood.ai/releases/1.3 (expires in 7 days).

liam: added webinar CTA to the landing page: "See the live demo 11:00 PT  Register". kept it short, form goes to marketing inbox + HubSpot.

nina: social copy draft: "Were rolling out v1.3: adaptive batching, lower token costs, and easier migration. Read the notes -> <docs link>. Join our live demo Wed 11:00 PT: <webinar link>." will refine tone and schedule.

matt: FYI ops: canary starts Thu 09:00 PT. fallback policy -> hold traffic on v1.2 for 2 hours if p95 latency regresses >10%. deployment command used: ```deployctl rollout start --env=prod --tag=v1.3 --canary=10% --watch``` 

jamal: added benchmark appendix and linked to the full perf report in the docs. permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/reports/batching-benchmarks-v1.3

nina: outstanding items checklist: 1) confirm blog hero copy (done), 2) finalize social cards (taking screenshots from preview), 3) webinar registration link (liam), 4) changelog link (matt), 5) docs canonical (jamal). If were green on all by 5pm, Ill queue the schedule for 09:00 PT release. :rocket:

liam: deck uploaded to drive and attached to the webinar invite. Ill run a quick dry run Tue 10am PT.

nina: awesome. setting the scheduled publish. Will post final URLs here when scheduled. Thanks team! :tada:
